# Run detail: live view, static graph, phase cards, task table (GMD-09)

## What to build

Rebuild `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx` (route `/runs/:ws/:runId`) as on boards `10-run-detail-live-light`, `11-run-detail-live-dark`, `12-run-detail-finished-800-px`, and the left part of `13-run-detail-landed-create-pr-light`, plus the "RUN DETAIL · IFRAME LOADING / PAGE WENT DOWN" state on `19-…`. Extend the server's run detail with the data the finished view needs, read from the engine's new `view.json` and from git.

The page polls `GET /api/runs/:ws/:runId` every 2 s (`POLL_MS`), keeps the last data and pauses while `document.hidden`.

**Header (sticky):**

- A **‹ Runs** back link, then a vertical divider.
- The run id (mono, 600) and `<StatusBadge kind="run">`.
- A meta line in mono `--fg3`: `<fullPath> · <provider> · started <relative> · <merged>/<total> merged`. When not live, add ` · page not live`.
- At the right:
  - **Open terminal here**: POST `/api/terminals` `{workspaceId}`, then navigate to `/terminals?focus=<id>`.
  - **open ↗**: only while live. It opens the `viewUrl` in a new tab.

**Live** (`summary.live && summary.viewUrl`):

- A full-height iframe of `viewUrl + "?theme=" + resolvedTheme`. The engine may ignore the parameter.
  - CSS: `flex:1; border:0; min-height:0` inside a flex column of height `100dvh` minus the header. The page itself must not scroll.
- A skeleton overlay ("Connecting to the run page…", three grey placeholder cards) until the iframe's `onLoad`.
- **Probe:** every 5 s, `fetch(viewUrl + "state", {cache:"no-store"})`. Two failures in a row, or the summary turning `live:false`, switch to the static view with a warn banner: "The run page stopped responding. Showing the static graph." and a **Retry** button that re-probes and goes back to the iframe if it answers.
- Mount the iframe only while live, and don't remount it on every poll. Key it by `viewUrl`.

**Finished** (or fallback):

- **Phase cards row** (4 cards in one bordered strip). Each card has a tone dot + title, a status line in the tone colour, and a mono detail line. Computed from `view` (the run's `view.json`) and `state`:
  - **Validation:**
    - gate status merged/done → "passed" (ok)
    - failed → "failed" (bad)
    - never started → "not reached" (mute)
    - running → "running" (live)

    Detail: "typecheck · lint" when known, else "validation commands".
  - **Review + live test:** from `agents.reviewer` and `agents.tester`:
    - "passed · N findings" (ok), "failed" (bad), "running" (live) or "not reached" (mute)
    - N = the sum of `summary.reports[].findings`.

    Detail: "reviewer + tester".
  - **Fixer:** "`<used>` / `<fixPasses>` passes" (ok if the run applied, else warn or bad), or "not reached". Used = `agents.fixer.round ?? rounds ?? 0`, and the budget is `summary.fixPasses`. Detail: "N findings fixed" when known, else "0 / N passes".
  - **Landed:**
    - status applied → "<files> files uncommitted" (ok), with the detail "+A −D in <fullPath>" from `landed`
    - done → "landed" (mute)
    - failed or aborted → "not landed" (bad)
    - running → "pending" (mute)
- **Task graph card:**
  - Title "Task graph" with "<merged>/<total> merged" in mono. At the right, the caption "columns = dependency layers".
  - Columns `LAYER 0`… from `graph.layers`. Node cards (≈200×64): title, then the mono id and a status word in the task tone, plus a tone dot.
  - Edges are SVG cubic curves from the right middle of the dependency to the left middle of the dependent, in `--bd2`. Board 13 shows them.
  - The card scrolls horizontally if it is too wide.
  - Clicking a node scrolls to its row in the task table and highlights it.
- **Task table:** Status (`<StatusBadge kind="task">`) | Task (title, with the mono id under it) | Attempt | Elapsed (`2m10s`, `48s`, `—`) | Lines (`+212` in ok, `−4` in bad; `—` when unknown) | Depends on (`← 01, 03` mono, `—` when none).
- **Right column:** a placeholder `<section id="pr" data-testid="pr-panel">` card titled "Pull request" with a `<ForgeChip>`.
  - Keep the current PR form behaviour inside it (today's `RunDetail.tsx` has a Create PR form using `GET/POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/pr`). Move it as is into `pages/PrPanel.tsx` and restyle it with the kit. A later task rebuilds it with step progress.
  - Layout: two columns (main + 340px panel) above 1100px. Below that, the panel goes under the table (board 12).
- **Suites:** the detail has no graph. Show the header, the live iframe if live, else an EmptyState "Suite <id> — open its page while it runs to see the features." and the status.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx` (269 lines) and `RunDetail.test.tsx`: today's page (iframe vs static graph, PR form). Rewrite them.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/runs.ts`: `RunDetailResponse`, `GraphNode`, `RunGraph`. Extend them.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts`:
  - lines 33–51: `GraphNode`, `RunGraph`, `RunDetail`
  - lines 135–207: `taskTitle`, `layersOf`, `buildGraph(state)`, which reads the task files from `state.tasksDir`
  - lines 209–224: `runDetail(ws, runId)`
  - line 227: `runDirOf`
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (lines 64–71): `GET /api/runs/:ws/:runId`.
- Engine: `import { readViewJson, type ViewJson } from "graph-execution/api"` (added by the engine task):
  - `nodes[id]`: `{status, attempt?, attempts?, startedAt?, endedAt?, added?, deleted?, files?, error?}`. Times are epoch ms.
  - `gate?`, `agents.{gateFixer,reviewer,tester,fixer}?`, `merge?`
  - `phase`
  - `summary?: {exitCode, fixPasses, reports: {findings}[], abort?, merge?: {target, ok, reason?}}`
  - `testPlan?`
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/pr.ts` (lines 51–53): the pathspec that excludes `.graph-execution` (`["--", ".", ":(exclude).graph-execution"]`) and the `git()` helper pattern. Use the same exclusion for `landed`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.test.ts`: fixtures for fake runs with `state.json` and task files. Add a `view.json` there.
- The boards: `10-…png/.html`, `11-…png`, `12-…png/.html` (finished, failed, 800px, layers, "not reached"), `13-…png/.html` (applied: phase cards, graph with edges, table). Copy the measurements from the `.html`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` (+ `runs.test.ts`)

- `RunDetail` gains these fields:
  - `view?: ViewJson`
  - `tasks?: Array<{ id; title; status; attempts: number; startedAt?: number; endedAt?: number; added?: number; deleted?: number; deps: string[]; error?: string }>`. Ordered by layer, then id. Merges `state.tasks` (status, attempts), `view.nodes` (times, lines, error) and the task files (title, deps).
  - `landed?: { files: number; added: number; deleted: number }`. Only when `state.status === "applied"`:
    - files: the line count of `git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude).graph-execution'`
    - added/deleted: the sum of `git diff --numstat HEAD -- . ':(exclude).graph-execution'`, plus the line counts of untracked files (cap each file at 10k lines; skip binaries, whose numstat is `-`)
- `buildGraph` already reads the deps. Reuse that work rather than reading the task files twice.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/runs.ts`

- Mirror the new fields.
- Add `formatElapsed(ms)` → `2m10s` / `48s` / `1h02m`.

### REWRITE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx`; CREATE `pages/RunDetail.css`, `pages/TaskGraph.tsx` (layered graph with SVG edges, reused by the Terminals run pane: export `<TaskGraph graph tasks? compact? onSelect? />`), `pages/PhaseCards.tsx`, `pages/PrPanel.tsx` (the moved PR form)

### REWRITE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RunDetail.test.tsx`; ADD `TaskGraph.test.tsx`, `runs.test.ts` (formatElapsed)

- Live: renders an iframe with `src` starting with the viewUrl. A failing probe (stubbed fetch rejects twice, fake timers) switches to the static graph with the "stopped responding" banner. **Retry** goes back.
- Finished applied: the phase cards read "passed", "passed · 3 findings", "1 / 3 passes" and "14 files uncommitted"; the table shows `2m10s`, `+212`, `← 01`.
- Failed: "not reached" on the later phases.
- TaskGraph: one SVG path per edge, nodes in layer columns.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A live fake run (hang script on `task:4`) shows the engine page in the iframe under the header, with no page scroll (`document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight` → 0).
- [ ] After **Close** in the iframe, or killing the run's page server, the page switches to the static graph with the banner within 10 s.
- [ ] A finished applied fake run shows the 4 phase cards, the layered graph with curved edges, and the task table with elapsed times and line counts (not `—`), from `view.json`.
- [ ] A failed fake run (task 3 fails 3 times) shows `failed` on node 03, `pending` on the tasks after it, and "not reached" on Review and Fixer.
- [ ] **Open terminal here** opens Terminals with a new terminal whose cwd is the workspace.
- [ ] Screenshots match boards 10, 11, 12 (`agent-browser set viewport 800 1500`) and 13 in light and dark.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -w graph-manager` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -w graph-manager -- RunDetail TaskGraph runs
npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run build -w graph-manager   # then agent-browser on a live and a finished run
```

---

## Shared context (same in every task of this run)

**Repo.** npm-workspaces monorepo. The engine is `packages/graph-execution` (published CLI, library entry `graph-execution/api` = `packages/graph-execution/src/api.ts`). The product is `apps/graph-manager`: Fastify 5 server in `src/server/`, React 19 + react-router 7 + Vite UI in `src/web/`, tests with vitest (server: `fastify.inject` via `src/server/test-helpers.ts`; UI: `// @vitest-environment jsdom` + `@testing-library/react` with `fetch` stubbed by `vi.stubGlobal`, see `src/web/App.test.tsx`). The spec is `docs/prd/graph-manager-design.md`.

**The design.** `docs/design/graph-manager/` holds every board of the design as `NN-name.png` (screenshot, open it with your image-reading tool and LOOK at it), `NN-name.txt` (all its text) and `NN-name.html` (its real HTML/CSS, fonts stripped; copy measurements, colors and structure from here). Boards: `00-ia-proposal-react-notes`, `01-design-system`, `02-component-nav-rail`, `03-login-light`, `04-login-dark`, `05-runs-dashboard-light-start-run-open`, `06-runs-dashboard-dark`, `07-terminals-light-2-2-split`, `08-terminals-dark`, `09-terminals-800-px`, `10-run-detail-live-light`, `11-run-detail-live-dark`, `12-run-detail-finished-800-px`, `13-run-detail-landed-create-pr-light`, `14-run-detail-landed-create-pr-dark`, `15-workspaces-clone-light`, `16-workspaces-clone-dark`, `17-settings-forges-light`, `18-settings-forges-dark`, `19-empty-loading-error-dialogs-light`, `20-empty-loading-error-dialogs-dark`. Mock data in the boards (octo/hello, dev-vm-01, counts) is illustrative: show real data from the API. Where a board shows something impossible with real data, keep the layout and use real values.

**Shared UI contracts.** Tasks run in parallel, so everyone uses these exact names. Task 2 creates the `ui/` kit, task 3 creates the shell, overview and keys; later tasks only consume them (and may add optional fields to shared types in place).

- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/tokens.css`: CSS variables `--bg --sf --sf2 --bd --bd2 --fg --fg2 --fg3 --ac --acbg --term --termfg` (values from `01-design-system`), status tones `--live --live-bg --ok --ok-bg --warn --warn-bg --bad --bad-bg --mute --mute-bg --rev --rev-bg`, `--space-1`…`--space-8` (4 8 12 16 20 24 32 48 px), `--radius-sm/md/lg` (4/6/10), `--control-h` 36px, `--control-h-dense` 32px, `--row-h` 40px, `--nav-w` 232px, `--rail-w` 56px, `--dur-fast` 120ms, `--dur-base` 180ms, `--font-sans` (Geist Variable, system-ui…), `--font-mono` (Geist Mono Variable, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas). Light on `:root`, dark on `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. Components use only `var(--…)`, never hex.
- `ui/base.css` (imported once in `main.tsx`): global classes `.btn` (+ `.btn-primary`, `.btn-danger`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-sm`), `.input`, `.select`, `.textarea`, `.field` (`.field-label`, `.field-hint`, `.field-error`), `.card`, `.table` with `.table-row` / `.table-row.focused` / `.table-group`, `.chip`, `.mono`, `.num` (tabular-nums), `.muted`, `.page`, `.page-header`. Focus ring: 2px `var(--ac)` outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element.
- `ui/status.ts`: `type Tone = "live" | "ok" | "warn" | "bad" | "mute" | "rev"`, `type Glyph = "pulse" | "dot" | "ring" | "dashed" | "diamond" | "bar" | "half"`, `toneOf(kind: "run" | "task" | "term", value: string, exitCode?: number): Tone`, `glyphOf(kind, value, exitCode?): Glyph`. Mapping: run running→live/pulse, applied→ok/dot, done→mute/ring, aborted→mute/bar, failed→bad/diamond, review→rev/half; task running|validating|merging→live/pulse, merged→ok/dot, failed→bad/diamond, pending→mute/dashed; term working→live/pulse, idle→warn/half, exited with 0→mute/ring, exited with ≠0→bad/diamond.
- `ui/StatusBadge.tsx`: `<StatusBadge kind="run"|"task"|"term" value={string} exitCode?={number} label?={string} />` renders `<span className="badge tone-<tone>" data-tone=<tone>>` with the glyph and `label ?? value` (term exited shows `exited <code>`). Also exports `<StatusGlyph tone glyph />` and `<LiveDot />` (blue pulsing dot + "live").
- `ui/Icon.tsx`: `<Icon name=… size?={16} />`, inline SVG, `currentColor`. Names: `logo runs terminal folder settings search plus close external moon sun monitor logout chevron-left chevron-right chevron-down branch maximize layout-1 layout-2 layout-4 info git refresh`.
- `ui/Drawer.tsx`: `<Drawer open title onClose footer?>` right-side panel (360px; full width under 900px), Esc closes, focus goes back to the opener.
- `ui/Dialog.tsx`: `<ConfirmDialog open title body confirmLabel cancelLabel? tone?: "danger" | "primary" onConfirm onCancel extraAction?: {label, onClick} />` (role `dialog`, Esc = cancel, shows `Esc` kbd on Cancel).
- `ui/Segmented.tsx`: `<Segmented options={{value, label}[]} value onChange ariaLabel />` (role `radiogroup`, buttons role `radio`).
- `ui/Kbd.tsx` `<Kbd>Ctrl K</Kbd>`; `ui/ForgeChip.tsx` `<ForgeChip forge="github"|"gitlab" />` (mono caps chip GITHUB/GITLAB); `ui/Skeleton.tsx` `<SkeletonRows rows={4} />`; `ui/EmptyState.tsx` `<EmptyState title body? action? />`; `ui/Progress.tsx` `<Progress value={0..1} tone={Tone} />`.
- `ui/toast.tsx`: `<ToastProvider>` and `useToast(): { show(t: { tone: "ok" | "bad" | "live"; text: string; action?: { label: string; to?: string; onClick?: () => void } }): void }`. Bottom-right stack, auto-dismiss after 6 s.
- `ui/theme.ts`: `type ThemePref = "system" | "light" | "dark"`, `getThemePref()`, `setThemePref(p)` (`localStorage["gm.theme"]`, every access in try/catch), `applyTheme()` (sets `document.documentElement.dataset.theme` to the resolved `light`/`dark`, follows `matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)")` while `system`), `useTheme(): { pref, setPref, resolved }`.
- `src/web/types.ts`: the client copies of the API shapes: `RunSummary`, `TerminalInfo`, `WorkspaceEntry`, `ForgesInfo`. Add optional fields in place when your task adds them on the server.
- `src/web/overview.tsx`: `<OverviewProvider>` and `useOverview(): { runs: RunSummary[]; terminals: TerminalInfo[]; workspaces: WorkspaceEntry[]; workspacesRoot?: string; forges: ForgesInfo; loaded: boolean; updatedAt?: number; failures: number; stale: boolean; refresh(): Promise<void> }`. It polls `GET /api/runs`, `/api/terminals`, `/api/workspaces`, `/api/forges` every 2 s with `Promise.allSettled`, pauses while `document.hidden`, keeps the last good data, and sets `stale` after 3 failed polls in a row. Also `<UpdatedAgo />` ("updated 1s ago", amber when stale) and `<StaleBanner />` ("Can't reach the server. Showing data from 14s ago. Retrying…").
- `src/web/keys.ts`: `useKey(combo, handler, opts?: { enabled?: boolean; allowInInput?: boolean })` with combos like `"s"`, `"p"`, `"/"`, `"Escape"`, `"Ctrl+k"`, `"Ctrl+Enter"`; `isTypingTarget(el)` (input, textarea, select, contenteditable, or inside `.xterm`); `useListNav(count, { onOpen(i) }): [index, setIndex]` (j/k/Enter, ignored while typing). The shell handles `g r|t|w|s`, `Ctrl+k`, and `/` (focuses the first `[data-filter]` element on the page).
- Routes and query strings: `/runs?status=failed|live|ready&workspace=<id>`, `/runs/:ws/:runId`, `/terminals?workspace=<id>` (opens a new terminal there), `?focus=<terminalId>`, `?filter=working|idle|other`, `?run=<ws>/<runId>` (opens that run in a pane), `/workspaces?clone=1` (opens the clone drawer), `/settings`. Page roots keep `data-testid="page-runs" | "page-terminals" | "page-workspaces" | "page-settings" | "page-run-detail" | "page-login"`.
- Each page keeps its CSS in its own file next to it (`pages/Runs.css` imported by `pages/Runs.tsx`), so parallel tasks don't edit one stylesheet.

**Look at what you build.** For any UI change, build and run graph-manager and look at it in a real browser with `agent-browser` (installed globally; run `agent-browser skills get core` once if you need its command reference):

```bash
npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run build -w graph-manager
GM_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-forge.mjs 7421 $GM_DIR/forge &      # fake GitHub/GitLab; tokens gh-good / gl-good
GM_PASSWORD=pw GM_PORT=7420 GM_DATA_DIR=$GM_DIR/data GM_WORKSPACES_DIR=$GM_DIR/ws \
  GM_GITHUB_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7421/github node apps/graph-manager/dist/server/main.js &
agent-browser open http://127.0.0.1:7420/ && agent-browser snapshot -i
agent-browser set viewport 1440 900 && agent-browser screenshot /tmp/gm.png   # then open /tmp/gm.png and compare it with the board
```

Use another port if 7420/7421 are taken. Log in with `pw`. Check light and dark (`agent-browser eval 'document.documentElement.dataset.theme'`). Start runs with `--provider fake` only, never a real provider. Stop the servers by PID (`kill <pid>`), never by name. More recipes are in the graph-manager section of `TESTING.md`.

**Validation.**

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager                       # and `npm test -w graph-execution` if you touched the engine
```

Known environment failure: `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts` "exits 2 at startup when --provider claude is not on the PATH" fails wherever a real `claude` is installed next to `node`. Ignore that one case only.
